svg.text: X-R-MiTNet: Explainable Reliability-Aware Vision Transformer Architecture
Multi-Task Medical Framework for Early Brain Tumor Detection, Auxiliary Pure-Transformer Pixel-Wise Segmentation, and CARE-XAI Attribution

g.text: Exploits Anatomical Mirror Invariance across Brain Midline
G_asym = σ( W_2 · GELU( W_1 · |x - x_mirror| ) ) ∈ [0, 1]
Multi-Head Attention on Modulated Tokens: x̂ = x · (1 + G_asym)
Attention(Q, K, V) = Softmax( (Q K^T) / √d_k ) V (H = 8 Heads, d_k = 32)
ℒ_Total = ℒ_Evidential(α, y) + λ_seg · ℒ_DiceBCE(M̂, M_gt)
Where ℒ_Evidential = ℒ_ACE + min(1.0, t/T_anneal) · λ_KL · KL[ Dir(α̃) ‖ Dir(1) ] and ℒ_DiceBCE = 0.5 ℒ_Dice + 0.5 ℒ_BCE
